entries.12920a9863c970e7: It is the group's core business, engaged in real estate brokerage and related operations. As of the end of December 2025, it operated 24 stores in total (12 in the Hanshin and Hokusetsu areas and central Osaka in the Kansai region, 6 in Nagoya in the Chubu region and 6 in the Tokyo area) and, staying close to local communities, it collects information on real estate trends, customer needs and property listings. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, external revenue was ¥3,664 million.
entries.1726f7af47abe485: The company and its consolidated subsidiary Renowest Co., Ltd. engage in the procurement, planning, development and sale of detached houses and residential land. Design and construction are handled by outside contractors, and the business makes use of sale information and information on prospective customers gathered at Distribution Business stores. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, external revenue was ¥8,089 million.
